tasks.label: Welcome
args: if [ -f .venv/bin/activate ]; then cat scripts/dev/next_steps.txt; else cat scripts/dev/welcome_message.txt; fi
if (Test-Path .venv\Scripts\activate) { Get-Content scripts\dev\next_steps.txt } else { Get-Content scripts\dev\welcome_message.txt }

tasks.label: Run Quick Tests
tasks.detail: Stop on first failure with short traceback

tasks.label: Run Tests with Coverage
tasks.detail: Run tests with coverage report (HTML in htmlcov/)

tasks.label: Run Single Test File
tasks.detail: Run tests in the currently open file

tasks.label: 🐳 Check Docker Status
tasks.detail: Verify Docker is installed and running before executing Docker commands

tasks.label: 🚀 HA: Start
tasks.detail: Start HA with info logging (restart if already running)

tasks.label: 🚀 HA: Start (Debug)
tasks.detail: Start HA with debug logging for all integration namespaces

tasks.label: ⏹️ HA: Stop
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down && echo '✅ Home Assistant stopped'

tasks.label: 🗑️ HA: Clean All Data (Reset)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v && docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)/test-ha-config:/data" alpine rm -rf /data/* /data/.[!.]* 2>/dev/null; echo '✅ All Home Assistant data cleaned'

tasks.label: 🔎 HA: Check Integration Status
tasks.command: docker exec ha-internet-health-test bash -c 'echo "=== Integration Files ==="; ls -la /config/custom_components/internet_health_monitor/ 2>&1 | head -10; echo ""; echo "=== Recent Integration Logs ==="; grep -i internet_health_monitor /config/home-assistant.log 2>&1 | tail -10 || echo "No logs found (HA may not have started yet)"'
tasks.detail: Check if the integration is loaded and view any errors

tasks.label: 🛠️ HA: Fix Port Conflicts
tasks.detail: Stop any processes using port 8123 and clean up containers

tasks.label: 🩺 HA: Diagnose Port 8123
tasks.command: echo '=== Checking what is using port 8123 ===' && echo '' && echo 'Method 1: lsof' && sudo lsof -i :8123 2>/dev/null || echo 'No results from lsof' && echo '' && echo 'Method 2: netstat' && sudo netstat -tulpn 2>/dev/null | grep 8123 || echo 'No results from netstat' && echo '' && echo 'Method 3: ss' && sudo ss -tulpn 2>/dev/null | grep 8123 || echo 'No results from ss' && echo '' && echo '=== Docker containers ===' && docker ps -a && echo '' && echo '=== Docker networks ===' && docker network ls
tasks.detail: Show detailed info about what's using port 8123

tasks.label: Docker: Build Image
tasks.detail: Build Docker image for the component

tasks.label: Docker: Run Tests in Container
tasks.command: docker run --rm -v ${workspaceFolder}:/app -w /app python:3.12-slim bash -c 'pip install -q -r requirements-dev.txt && pytest'
tasks.detail: Run tests in a fresh Docker container

tasks.label: Run Pre-commit on All Files
tasks.detail: Run all pre-commit hooks on entire codebase

tasks.label: Full CI Check
args: echo '=== Lint ===' && ruff check . && echo '=== Format ===' && black --check . && echo '=== Type Check ===' && mypy custom_components/internet_health_monitor --ignore-missing-imports && echo '=== Tests ===' && pytest && echo '=== All checks passed!'

Write-Host '=== Lint ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; ruff check .; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Write-Host '=== Format ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; black --check .; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Write-Host '=== Type Check ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; mypy custom_components/internet_health_monitor --ignore-missing-imports; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Write-Host '=== Tests ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; pytest; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Write-Host '=== All checks passed!' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.detail: Run full CI pipeline locally (lint, format, type check, tests)
